content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Sovereign commerce infrastructure means you own the entire stack that powers your digital store. No third-party platforms. No subscriptions. No geographic restrictions. It’s built on open tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and blockchain payments via NOWPayments. This architecture is designed to be censorship-resistant and cost-effective. For example, instead of relying on Stripe, you accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee. Instead of renting space on Gumroad, you host your store on GitHub Pages—free and globally accessible. The key difference? After deployment, COREMERCH has no access. You own the code, the data, and the payment flow. This isn’t a patch for broken systems—it’s a new foundation built for creators in regions where traditional platforms fail.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the breakdown: Your store lives on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process orders and trigger file delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your stack. Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, also free. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which verifies crypto transactions on-chain and fires a webhook to deliver the product instantly. For example, a buyer pays in USDT on the TRON network (under $0.10 in fees). NOWPayments confirms the payment, triggers the webhook, and your customer gets their download link—all without you touching a line of code. This system is lightweight, fast, and impervious to local banking restrictions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is for digital creators in Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, and other regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell digital products but struggle to collect payment, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who want full ownership of their commerce stack—no platform lock-in, no data harvesting, no unexpected shutdowns. For example, a graphic designer in Accra selling font packs can deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and start accepting payments in USDC within 48 hours. An educator in Kumasi selling online courses can use the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to automate delivery and configure email security. This isn’t a tool for victims—it’s for creators who choose better architecture.
Blockchain payments remove geographic barriers—no bank or platform can block your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component is selected for its reliability, cost, and sovereignty. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages provide free, fast hosting with global CDN distribution. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script handle backend tasks without servers. Supabase and Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 deliver files instantly. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with no KYC, no buyer accounts, and a flat 0.5% fee. For example, if you sell a $50 ebook, the fee is $0.25—far lower than PayPal’s 4.5% + $0.30. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates to deploy these components yourself. It’s not a course—it’s a kit to build and own your infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing a stack based on your needs. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is ideal for 1-3 products, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) supports up to 5 products with email security. If you want to build yourself, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates. Deployment takes 48 hours or less. For example, a photographer in Cape Coast selling presets can use Stack 01 to accept payments in BNB and deliver files automatically. A developer in Tamale selling plugins can use Stack 02 to configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC and ensure email deliverability. The key is to start—sovereign commerce isn’t a theory; it’s a deployable system. Your store, your rules, your earnings.

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-owned digital commerce stack that allows creators to sell products without relying on third-party platforms like Stripe or PayPal. It uses free hosting (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages), backend tools (Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script), and blockchain payments (NOWPayments) to process orders and deliver products automatically. This architecture is designed to bypass geographic restrictions and give creators full control over their store, data, and payment flow.
You own the entire stack after deployment—no subscriptions, no platform lock-in.

Ready to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack? The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints, templates, and guides to build and own your infrastructure. From hosting to payment processing, every component is explained step by step. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for 1-3 products or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for up to 5 products with email security. 2. Gather your assets: product files, descriptions, and pricing. 3. Deploy your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Upload product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 8. Test end-to-end: place a test order and ensure file delivery works. 9. Launch your store and share the link with your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I accept local currency payments with this system?

No, this system uses blockchain payments via NOWPayments, which accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies. Buyers can pay using stablecoins like USDT or USDC, which are pegged to the USD. This bypasses local currency restrictions entirely.
Do I need to know how to code to use this?

Basic technical understanding is helpful, but the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes templates and blueprints to guide you. If you prefer, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you within 48 hours.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments is a decentralized payment processor with no single point of failure. Even if their service experiences issues, your store remains operational because the payment verification happens on-chain. You retain full access to your infrastructure.
How do I handle refunds with crypto payments?

Refunds are processed by sending the equivalent crypto amount back to the buyer’s wallet. Since transactions are on-chain, you can verify the original payment and issue a refund directly, with no platform involvement.
Can I scale this system as my business grows?

Yes, the infrastructure is designed to scale. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes a scaling playbook to upgrade components as needed. For example, you can move from Google Sheets to Supabase for larger order volumes or add more products to your stack.
